items.question: What further accomplishments are granted to the cremation-ground cakra worshipper?
premises: The previous verse states that the worshipper obtains sword-accomplishment, vetāla-accomplishment, and pill-accomplishment.
This verse adds attainment together with great-hero accomplishment.
This verse further specifies an accomplishment arising from a yakṣiṇī and a servant.
items.inference: Therefore, the same ritual practice also yields great-hero accomplishment and an accomplishment arising from a yakṣiṇī-servant.
uncertainties: Whether yakṣiṇī+ceṭaka+udbhavām qualifies an implied siddhi or names a distinct attainment is not explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: He also obtains, together with the great-hero accomplishment, that which arises from a yakṣiṇī and a servant.
